notes.title: New Update released
notes.notes:
Hi guys! New update just been released for he game:


    A lot of people complained about game being too difficult even on normal, so I reduced difficulty a little. 
    Medkits give more health now
    Less enemies on level 3
    Blade mutants move speed reduced a little
    Enemies spawn points were updated, so there will be less chance that enemy will spawn on top of the player
    Rocket launcher damage was doubled
    A lot of minor bug fixes


Thabk you for your feedback and your support!

notes.title: Massive update released!
notes.notes:
New update just released on Steam, addressing a lot of complains from users who tried the game.


    Level design completely changed, levels became more focused and fun

    Quick save/quick load system changed to checkpoint system

    Added secondary fire mode for shotgun, and also shotgun stats has changed

    New enemies were added and some of the old ones changed or removed

    Music was added and some sound were changed


and a lot, lot more! 
Thank you for your support!
